# 12 — Review date boundary behaviour

## Objective
Trace date inputs, local-time defaults, publication calculation, expiry comparison, and boundary assumptions.
## Required context and areas
Inspect `Notice`, create/edit controller actions, views, tests, seed dates, and baseline prose.
## Change constraints
Analysis and tests only; do not alter date policy without explicit review.
## Response format
Data-flow; observed comparisons; boundary table; time-zone assumptions; conflicts; candidate tests; SME questions.
## Assumptions
Do not presume UTC, inclusive expiry, or calendar-day semantics.
## Validation and evidence
Run only deterministic tests; state environment assumptions and record commands/results in evidence.
